plugins.Author: Nala Praline
plugins.Name: NalaPF
plugins.Punchline: Auto-recreate your Party Finder after reco or datacenter switch
plugins.Description:
Captures your PF configuration and automatically recreates it after a disconnect or datacenter switch.

Commands:
/pfr
plugins.Changelog: Shouts no longer need a reconnect, so the PF is no longer recreated after a disconnect or a data center switch. The rest is cleaned up: saved PFs, Recreate now and the 60 minute refresh stay.

plugins.Author: Nala Praline, Asuna
plugins.Name: VenueScope
plugins.Description:
Browse FFXIV community events directly in-game. Filter by data center, time, and tags.

Commands:
/venuescope or /vs: open VenueScope
plugins.Changelog: Much smaller and fewer downloads for the FFXIV Venues list, and switching region now logs your other character in and travels from an aetheryte. The teleport after switching character no longer cuts its animation.
